Google Cloud outage disrupts UK services

A Google Cloud outage in London on Tuesday disrupted services for multiple financial companies and public sector websites in the UK. The disruption affected banking services, and court hearings were put on hold. Google reported that cloud services were restored later on Tuesday, with most customers back online. Experts noted the incident highlights the UK's reliance on a few major cloud providers.
